stress_convention: Positive sigma/N=tension; sigma=c0+cx*x+cy*y per SIGNED physical action. Mx multiplies +y, My multiplies -x.

N_tension.ULS_pure_effort_role: Pure-component line-stress normalization only, NOT a design resistance or exterior-fibre strength.
N_tension.scope: Normal line stress of this pure component only; not complete section/member resistance.
N_tension.proof: EN1993-1-3 6.1.2 gross-area normal yielding component only; net fracture is not checked.

N_tension.fixed_point_statement: Every local rho=1 and every compressed As has Eq.5.17 As_red/As=1 exactly. Thus geometry, centroid, stiffness and pure ULS stresses remain unchanged on re-evaluation; this is an integral effective-section fixed point.

N_compression.fixed_point_statement: Uniform ULS compression determines local widths and As reduction independently of N magnitude or centroid. Steps1-2 are used without optional step3 refinement; this is not an integral effective section.
